verses.1: But when he looked at those who were throwing their coins into the chest, he saw that they had very wealthy amounts of money in them.
verses.2: And he saw some old women throwing things there, about two thin strands at a time.
verses.3: And he said, “I truly tell you that this poor woman gave more than anyone else.”
verses.4: For all of them, they put everything they had into the offerings. But she, from her own resources, gave away everything she owned during her lifetime.
verses.5: And regarding some things related to the temple, he said that it was decorated with beautiful stones and various ornaments.
verses.6: Consider this: there will be days when no stone will be placed on top of another stone, and nothing will be broken.
verses.7: They asked him, “Teacher, when will this happen? And what is the sign when it does happen?”
verses.8: And he said, “Do not be deceived. Many will come to me, saying, ‘I am He.’ But beware; do not go back to them.”
verses.9: When you hear about wars and chaos, do not be discouraged. After all, these things will happen first and foremost, but they won’t end immediately.
verses.10: Then he said to them: “A nation will rise against another nation, and a kingdom against another kingdom.”
verses.11: There will be large earthquakes, and there will also be floods and diseases in certain places. There will also be great signs from heaven.
verses.12: Before all this, they will put their hands on you and chase you away. They will throw you into prisons and detention centers. They will prevent anyone from approaching the kings and rulers in my name.
verses.13: It will be a test for you.
verses.14: Therefore, do not hesitate to confess your sins in your hearts.
verses.15: For I will give you wisdom and knowledge, and none of those who oppose or resist you will be able to do so.
verses.16: And they will also be handed over to parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will be killed by you.
verses.17: And you will be hated by everyone because of my name.
verses.18: And there will be no harm caused to your heads.
verses.19: In patience, you will be able to destroy your own souls.
verses.20: When you see Jerusalem surrounded by military forces, then you will know that its destruction is inevitable.
verses.21: Then those who were in Judea fled to the mountains. Those who were in the middle of them also fled. And those who were in the valleys did not enter them at all.
verses.22: Because these days of punishment are days in which all that has been written are fulfilled.
verses.23: You will also hear those sounds during breastfeeding. It will be a great burden on the earth, and it will cause anger among the people.
verses.24: And they will be killed with swords, and they will be scattered among all nations. Jerusalem will be under the control of various nations, until the time comes when those nations are punished.
verses.25: And there will be signs in the sun, in the moon, and in the stars. Also, on the earth, there will be gatherings of nations to listen to the sounds of the sea and the waves.
verses.26: When people are freed from fear and anticipation regarding those who come to their homes, then the powers of heaven will be at their service.
verses.27: And at that time, one will see the son of man coming in the clouds, with great power and glory.
verses.28: Starting from these points, you should raise your heads up and look around. For it will be time for your separation to begin.
verses.29: And he said a parable to them: “See the fig tree and all the trees.”
verses.30: When they have already been displayed, then, seeing this for yourselves, you will realize that the place is already empty.
verses.31: And you also, when you see these things happening, remember that the kingdom of God is very close at hand.
verses.32: I truly tell you that this situation will not end until it happens completely.
verses.33: The sky and the earth will be removed from their places, but my words will not be removed from their places.
verses.34: Be careful, for your hearts may become weary and heavy with sorrow and despair. And then, a sudden day of disaster will come upon you.
verses.35: As it is written: It will surely be revealed to all those who are sitting down, in the face of the entire earth.
verses.36: And always, you should be prepared to flee from all these things that are about to happen. You must stand before the Son of Man.
verses.37: And he taught during the days in the temple. At night, he would go up to the mountain called Elaios.
verses.38: And all the people would come to him in the temple, to listen to his words.
